test_cases.title: Admin home page shows the Home heading and the menu links
acs: DERIVED: /home.aspx shows h1 Home and the links Home, Help, System Administration, Manage Contracts, Manage Schemes, Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor, Results Sign-off and System information - route /home.aspx
assumptions: The user is signed in with Windows integrated authentication and holds the admin role (project admin).
Menu link data: Home; Help; System Administration; Manage Contracts; Manage Schemes; Distributions; Test Consultant; Assessor; Results Sign-off; System information.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
steps.expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
Look for the Home and Help links in the menu.
steps.expected: The links Home and Help are visible.

steps.action: Look for the System Administration, Manage Contracts and Manage Schemes links in the menu.
steps.expected: The links System Administration, Manage Contracts and Manage Schemes are visible.

steps.action: Look for the Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor and Results Sign-off links in the menu.
steps.expected: The links Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor and Results Sign-off are visible.

steps.action: Look for the System information link in the menu without selecting it.
steps.expected: The System information link is visible and the h1 is still Home.

test_cases.title: Each menu link opens its menu page without an error page
acs: DERIVED: Each menu link on /home.aspx opens its destination page with the stated h1 and no server error page - routes listed in the data set
assumptions: The user is signed in with Windows integrated authentication and holds the admin role (project admin).

Data set (link -> route -> h1): System Administration -> /Admin/MenuAdmin.aspx -> System Administration; Manage Contracts -> /Contracts Admin/MenuContracts.aspx -> Manage Contracts; Manage Schemes -> /Scheme Admin/MenuSchemes.aspx -> Manage Schemes; Distributions -> /Distributions/MenuDistributions.aspx -> Distributions; Test Consultant -> /Test Consultant/MenuTestConsultants.aspx -> Test Consultant; Assessor -> /Assessor/MenuAssessor.aspx -> Assessor; Results Sign-off -> /Results Sign-off/SignOff.aspx -> Results Sign-off.
Links on each destination page are not followed.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 7 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Home.

steps.action: Click the System Administration link, then read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Admin/MenuAdmin.aspx, the h1 reads System Administration and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Manage Contracts link and read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Contracts Admin/MenuContracts.aspx, the h1 reads Manage Contracts and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Manage Schemes link and read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Scheme Admin/MenuSchemes.aspx, the h1 reads Manage Schemes and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Distributions link and read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Distributions/MenuDistributions.aspx, the h1 reads Distributions and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Test Consultant link and read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Test Consultant/MenuTestConsultants.aspx, the h1 reads Test Consultant and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Assessor link and read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Assessor/MenuAssessor.aspx, the h1 reads Assessor and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Results Sign-off link and read the main heading.
steps.expected: The address path is /Results Sign-off/SignOff.aspx, the h1 reads Results Sign-off and no server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Help link points to the quick reference guide
acs: DERIVED: The Help link on /home.aspx points to QuickReferenceGuide.pdf - route /home.aspx
assumptions: The user is signed in with Windows integrated authentication and holds the admin role (project admin).
The link target is inspected only; whether the PDF opens in a new tab is not asserted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Home.

steps.action: Locate the Help link in the menu.
Inspect the address (href) of the Help link without opening it.
Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Confirm the current page is still the home page.
steps.expected: The address path is /home.aspx and the h1 is still Home.
